records.subject: You're in -- let's get Silver Media set up
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-06-15) but nothing since; no invite sent, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach (email:de4735f3, email:11aae715). Six days of silence on Starter with 8 days left suggests low unaided odds, though the early project start shows some real intent.

draft.subject: One next step for Silver Media
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

You've got a real project up and running in Wrenfield already — nice start. The usual next step from here is bringing in a teammate: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if there are a few to add.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to look at how your project is organized and suggest who to add first.

Best,
Nadia
